finding2_sameProjectConfirmation.verdict: MECHANISM CONFIRMED at one repository's full scale: production binds 95.4% of the containment edges the count model called ambiguous, and 87.0% of them to a declaration in the edge's own file. The 8.5% cross-file bindings are the part worth acting on later — an eager `LIMIT 1` that prefers the own file still falls back to another file when the name is not declared in it.
finding2_sameProjectConfirmation.instrumentAnomalyDisclosed: On this run the store holds 39,293 `contains` rows while the same files through `parseFile` emitted 21,486 (1.83x). The other four types agree to within 2% (calls 400/400, imports 99/99, overrides 3/3, references 436/445). The 120-file draw published earlier shows the same direction at 1.006x (3,097/3,077). This is NOT explained here, it is NOT this lane's instrument to change, and the percentages above are therefore quoted as RATIOS over the stored set rather than as counts: the ratio that decides the ruling (bound vs not bound) is insensitive to it, the absolute counts are not. Flagged for the instrument's owner.
finding2_sameProjectConfirmation.whyTheDrawAndTheFullRepoDisagree: The 120-file draw pooled 120 files from 120 repositories; this run is one repository with 1,143 files. Same-file binding falls from 97.9% to 87.0% because a bigger project gives the fallback more other-file declarations to bind to — the direction the mechanism predicts.
